title: GOP Pollster Reportedly Shares Purportedly AI-Generated Images to Fabricate Appearance of Black Voter Support

behaviors.text: Purportedly AI-generated images circulated by GOP pollster [person] reportedly depicted Black men appearing to support the Republican Party shortly before Black History Month.
The allegedly fabricated photos created a misleading impression of racial diversity within the GOP and may have shaped [person] perception.
The episode raises concerns about the reported use of AI to distort political representation and the potential impact on Black communities.
